Title: Finland – Data services – Very high resolution (VHR) satellite data for monitoring land and water areas
Procedure title: Very high resolution (VHR) satellite data for monitoring land and water areas
Description: Finnish Environment Institute (Syke) is seeking for a provider of very high resolution (VHR) satellite data for monitoring coastal, lakes and adjacent land areas. The area of interest is (AoI) Finland and the surrounding coastal areas. Within this overall AoI Syke will define a number (approximately 10) of smaller monitoring areas. The data coverage should be almost daily (ignoring cloud cover), with seven (7) visible light bands and one (1) near Infrared band. Data should be in very high resolution (pixel size between 3 m and 5 m). Data should cover both new acquisitions and archive observations (consistent archive from 2022 onwards and with optimal predecessor prior to 2022). The main purpose of the data requirement is building non-cloudy time series over smaller monitoring areas within the AoI. These time series require as consistent /harmonized data source as possible. Archive data (prior 2022) may consist of predecessor of present instrument type. During 2025, we will perform testing and method development with historical data. Based on the development phase, Syke may use the option for purchasing data for operational monitoring purposes during 2026 – 2029. Data should be available for unlimited browsing from selected areas during the full contract period (one year). Additionally, Syke will download selected images which should have perpetual license.
